# Journal

> Journal is an open source notebook (AGPL-3.0) built on Homebase. Notes live on your device first, work offline, and sync encrypted to a space you own. You can share notes with people you know or publish them as public pages, write live Mermaid, SVG, HTML and React blocks inside a note, and let AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex CLI) read and write the folders you grant through the Journal MCP server.

Journal runs in the browser at https://journal.cloudx.run and signs in with a Homebase identity. Every feature in Journal today is free; a paid Pro plan for hosted extras is planned in the open in GitHub issue #306.

## Pages

- [Home]({{SITE}}/): what Journal is, where notes live, the editor, sharing and public pages, live blocks, and common questions
- [Agents]({{SITE}}/agents): install the Journal MCP server in Claude Code, Codex CLI or Claude Desktop, grant access folder by folder, and the fourteen tools
- [Pricing]({{SITE}}/pricing): the Free plan, the planned Pro plan, and questions about paying

## Docs

- [MCP server README](https://github.com/2002Bishwajeet/journal/blob/main/mcp/README.md): setup for each client, headless sign-in, and every tool
- [Authoring guide](https://github.com/2002Bishwajeet/journal/blob/main/mcp/AUTHORING.md): everything a note can hold and how to write it, including live blocks
